validate.title: Validerar UniFi Cloud Key
validate.instruction: Ställ först in Cloud Key i Inställningar.

errors.no_controller_connection: Det finns för närvarande ingen anslutning till UniFi-kontrollern. Kontrollera controlleruppgifterna i appinställningarna och försök igen.

settings.title: UniFi Nätverksinställningar
settings.instruction: Logga in med UniFi Network-användarens inloggningsuppgifter.
settings.nvrText: Använd port 443 för UniFiOS och port 8443 för Docker / Standalone.
settings.sslverify_hint: Standard: avmarkerad (rekommenderas foer de flesta installationer). Aktivera endast detta om din controller har ett giltigt betrott TLS-certifikat (inte sjaelvsignerat).
settings.apikey_hint: Obligatoriskt. Endast UniFi OS 7+. Skapa en API-nyckel i UniFi OS -> Inställningar -> API. Naer den aer satt anvaender v1 REST-anrop Bearer-autentisering i staellet foer sessionscookie.

networkV1.instruction: Log in with the credentials of the UniFi Network user (username & password).

networkV2.instruction: Connect using an API key (UniFi OS 7+). Create one in UniFi OS → Settings → API.
networkV2.nvrText: Use port 443 for UniFiOS and port 8443 for Docker / Standalone.

status.wizardHint: Want to reconfigure the connection using the step-by-step wizard?

settings.site_shared_hint: Delas med Network V1 - anvaends av baada anslutningarna.

welcome.title: Let's connect your UniFi controller
welcome.body: This wizard walks you through connecting Homey to your UniFi Network controller. Network V1 (username & password) is required for pairing devices. Network V2 (API key) is optional and only unlocks a few extra flow actions.

choose.title: Extra: Network V2
choose.body: Network V1 will be set up next — it is required to pair Wi-Fi clients, cable clients, access points and switches. You can optionally also enable Network V2 with an API key for a couple of extra flow actions (toggle a WLAN, restart an access point).
choose.v2desc: Optional. Unlocks the 'Toggle WLAN' and 'Restart access point' flow actions. Does not replace Network V1.

server.title: Controller address
server.body: Enter the IP address or hostname of your UniFi controller.
server.error: Please enter an IP address or hostname.

v1.title: Network V1 — username & password
v1.intro: Create a dedicated local admin user in UniFi for Homey to use.
v1.s1: Open your UniFi controller and go to Settings → Admins & Users.
v1.s2: Click Add Admin, disable MFA, and set a strong, unique password.
v1.s4: Enter that username and password below.
v1.error: Please fill in both username and password.

v2.title: Network V2 — API key
v2.intro: Create an API key in UniFi OS for extra flow actions.
v2.s2: Click Create New API Key and give it a name (e.g. homey-integration-key).
v2.s3: Copy the key — it is only shown once.
v2.s4: Paste it below. Network V2 only enables extra actions — device pairing still requires Network V1.

test.fail: Connection failed. Check the details and try again.

summary.title: Ready to save
summary.body: Review your connections below and finish setup.
